title: The Recipe That Needed a Second Taster
youtube_title: The Recipe That Needed a Second Taster | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Yael is just outside the fun, close to a recipe tasting that had forgotten to call the friend over. Uma changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Yael has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
